creator: James Van Straten
title: Strive acquires 1,109 bitcoin, raising total holdings to 16,500 coins
dc:creator: James Van Straten
content: ASST climbs 133% in three months as Strive grows holdings to 16,500 BTC and explores fresh capital raising options.
contentSnippet: ASST climbs 133% in three months as Strive grows holdings to 16,500 BTC and explores fresh capital raising options.

creator: James Van Straten
title: Strategy taps cash reserve to retire $1.5 billion in convertible debt
dc:creator: James Van Straten
content: Michael Saylor and team funded the repurchases using cash as it restructures liabilities tied to its BTC treasury strategy.
contentSnippet: Michael Saylor and team funded the repurchases using cash as it restructures liabilities tied to its BTC treasury strategy.

creator: Francisco Rodrigues
title: Spain joins growing list of countries shutting out Polymarket and Kalshi
dc:creator: Francisco Rodrigues
content: The platforms were blocked for operating without licenses required by Spanish gambling law, citing a lack of safeguards for minors and self-excluded gamblers.
contentSnippet: The platforms were blocked for operating without licenses required by Spanish gambling law, citing a lack of safeguards for minors and self-excluded gamblers.

creator: Shaurya Malwa
title: Bitcoin demand gauge sinks to worst level since December as spot buying weakens
dc:creator: Shaurya Malwa
content: CryptoQuant’s 30-day apparent demand indicator is negative, signaling that buyers aren’t absorbing the available supply and leaving the market vulnerable.
contentSnippet: CryptoQuant’s 30-day apparent demand indicator is negative, signaling that buyers aren’t absorbing the available supply and leaving the market vulnerable.

creator: Francisco Rodrigues
title: StablR freezes USDR and EURR after attacker mints $13.5 million in unbacked tokens
dc:creator: Francisco Rodrigues
content: The breach, linked to a 1-of-3 multisig wallet weakness, allowed attackers to compromise a key and mint $13.5 million in unbacked tokens, netting them $2.8 million.
contentSnippet: The breach, linked to a 1-of-3 multisig wallet weakness, allowed attackers to compromise a key and mint $13.5 million in unbacked tokens, netting them $2.8 million.
